verdict.rationale: Deel's people-teams offering supports employer-side immigration at team scale. It covers pre-hire eligibility checks, EOR-sponsored and own-entity-sponsored work permits, renewals, offboarding and policy consulting, and says you can consolidate mobility operations in one place. An immigration tab gives an overview of company mobility activities, and relocations can be managed across all entities on a single platform, with scale backed by 'thousands of visas across 50 countries.' Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-case management, and an explicitly stated startup/scale-up program or volume pricing (the founders track covers founder visas plus free Deel HR, not a team-scale program).
